title: Awnings.
officialText:
Awnings supported entirely from the building may be placed over unenclosed sidewalk cafés provided they are at least 8 feet (2438 mm) clear above the sidewalk and within the limits specified by the Commissioner of the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection. Such awnings shall be in compliance with Section 3105 of this code.
*Section 3111.3 was amended by Local Law 80 of 2020. This law has an effective date of August 28, 2020.
